assessment: PASS observed AM real-I timing interval
runtime_help: Pico ADC/DSP suite: commands are lowercase, one per line.
preset 0..8: BASIC, IQ-AM, IF-AM, IF-AMSYNC, IF-FM, IF-FSK, USB, LSB, IF-CW
mode basic|am|amsync|fm|usb|lsb|cw; input iq|i|q; tune -12000..12000 Hz
volume 0..100; squelch -1=off or 0..12; hang 0..7; swap 0|1; iqcorr 0|1
page 0..4 (4=timing); stream 0|1; status; help. Reboot resets settings and DSP history.
BASIC ignores receiver controls except gain/volume. IF forces swap/iqcorr off.
measure start|stop: all-block timing window; cumulative diagnostics never reset.
preset_verification: All current settings match preset 2; preset number itself is not exposed by status

analysis.historical_fault_note: Four additional deadline misses accumulated between the earlier preflight snapshot and this measurement start. None occurred inside the measured window; causes and block class of those earlier misses were not captured. This is not an uninterrupted-since-boot pass.
analysis.input_note: Q remains varying, inconsistent with intended quiet DC. IF-I digitally substitutes Q=2048 for receiver DSP, but raw statistics and near-rail checks still cover both ADC channels. No physical bias method or fresh scope voltage verified.
analysis.identity_limitation: Runtime self-reported label/source fingerprint matches published tested UF2; no running-binary readback.
